slide.text: Lagos can phase this procurement without losing momentum
The platform supports a phased implementation path that starts with urgent land-administration pain points and expands into broader parcel, field, builder, and oversight workflows over time.

text.p: Deploy parcel records, C of O workflow continuity, role-based queues, and audit-grade oversight for the core land-administration process.
Expand into web parcel maps, corridor overlays, field missions, offline continuity, and geofence-aware operating controls.
Add AI-assisted intake, cleaner document review, clearer status visibility, and lower-friction processing for formal projects.
Layer in revenue visibility, supervisor dashboards, statewide rollout discipline, and extension into related planning, infrastructure, and market-facing workflows.

slide.text: This phased path helps Lagos procure for immediate service gains while preserving a credible route to deeper geospatial, fiscal, and builder-facing modernization.
The platform can begin with urgent state land-administration bottlenecks and expand without replacing the underlying workflow foundation.
